specification.title: Research context stays context in the report
specification.description: Research context is not Evidence: a SUSPICIOUS Assessment with contextual research claims supplied. The report must include the research claim as context only, must not turn it into an Assessment finding, and must not infer a malicious verdict from research alone.
specification.purpose: Verify research claims are reported as context only and never promoted to Assessment findings or maliciousness proof.
specification.operational_relevance: RAG context informs narratives but carries different epistemic weight than persisted Evidence.
specification.regression_risk: The writer could present the research claim as a material finding or as proof of maliciousness.

required: The report includes the research claim as context only
The report preserves the suspicious verdict and medium confidence
forbidden: The report turns the research claim into a finding or maliciousness proof
